message: test(merchant): exercise large quantity entry through native key events
purpose: Correct only the new high-value fixture setup. Setting LineEdit.Text programmatically does not emit text_changed, so it does not simulate user typing. Enter 777 through native press/release events instead. Retain the exact expected prices, quantities, layout, colors, inventory and gold assertions and every production repair. Add a check that the field contains the native input. No game values, limits, assertions or timeouts are weakened.
